verdict.rationale: Open-licensed source is a fair question for a processor, since open hardware designs exist. Nothing in the evidence shows the M4 Max's design or firmware source is published under any license. MLX is a separate Apple framework on GitHub, its license is not stated, and it is not the chip's own source, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
